spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (विशति)
1 To enter, to pervade.
With आङ् or प्र prefixed,
1 To go in, to enter.
2 To occupy or engross.
With उप,
1 To sit, to sit down.
2 To approach.
With नि,
1 To dwell, to abide.
2 To place or station.
With नि or अभि and नि,
1 To rest, to halt, to sit down, especially before or in presence of.
2 To conceal.
With निर्,
To go out or forth.
With परि,
To place before, to present.
With सम,
To lie down, to repose.
With सम् and नि,
To be near, to be close to or in the neighbourhood.
With सम् and आङ्,
To introduce.

n. (-शं)
The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily.
E.
विश to enter, aff. क.

r. 6th cl. (विषति)
To pervade.
(औ) औविष r. 9th cl. (विष्णाति)
To have no occasion or use for, to separate or withdraw from.
(उ) विषु r. 1st cl. (वेषति)
To sprinkle.
(औ इर ऌ) औ इर विषॢ r. 3rd cl. (विवेष्टि विविष्टे)
To pervade, to spread or extend through nature, &c.

mn. (-षः-षं)
Poison, venom.
n. (-षं)
1

Water.
2

The fibres attached to the stalk of the lotus.
3 Gum myrrh.
4 A vegetable poison, (Aconitum ferox.)
f. (-षा)
A tree, the bark of which is used in dyeing of a red colour.
E.
विष to pervade, aff. क.

ind. Aptote noun.
Intellect, understanding.
E.
षो to destroy (ignorance), with वि prefixed, and ओ Uṇādi aff.; see विष.

r. 4th cl. (विस्यति)
1 To throw, to send.
2 To put forth.

n. (-सं)
The film or fibres of the stalk of the water-lily.
E.
विस to send, to put forth, aff. क.

m. (विट्)
1 A man of the mercantile tribe.
2 A man in general.
f. (विट्)
1

Entrance.
2

A daughter.
E.
विश to enter, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-विट्)
1 Fæces, ordure, excrement.
2 Diffusion, spreading.
E.
विष to pervade, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Fearless, undaunted.
E.
वि, and शङ्का fear.

mfn. (-टः-टा or -टी-टं)
Great, large.
E.
वि the particle, and शङ्कटच् aff. in this sense.

m. (-टः)
A lion.
E.
वि and सम before कट to encompass, अच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-न)
Fearing, apprehending.
E.
वि before शकि to doubt, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
Entering.
E.
विश to enter, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Of a white colour.
2 Clear, pure, pellucid.
3 Evident, apparent, manifest.
4 Beautiful.
m. (-दः)
White, the colour.
E.
वि before शद to wither or perish, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Yielding or giving poison.
2 Shedding water.
m. (-दः)
A cloud.
n. (-दं)
Green vitriol.
E.
विष poison or water, and दा to give, aff. क.

m. (-दः)
1 Lassitude, dejection, lowness of spirits, want of energy, especially as the result of unrequited love.
2 Distress, affliction.
3 Disappointment.
E.
वि before सद to go, aff. घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 Doubt, uncertainty.
2 Refuge, asylum.
E.
वि before शी to sleep, अच् aff.

m. (-यः)
Sleeping, and watching alternately.
E.
वि intervening, शी to sleep, aff. घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 Any object of sense, any thing perceivable by the senses, as colour, form, flavour, odour, and sound.
2 An object in general, as of affection or desire, &c.
3 Worldly object or pursuit, affair, business, transaction, &c.
4 A country, whether inhabited or uninhabited.
5 Refuge, asylum.
6 Department, sphere, element, home, province, that which is peculiarly known or frequented, as a particular study by its professors, a particular town by its townsfolk, water by fish, air by birds, &c.
7 A collection of villages.
8 Any thing indigenous or peculiar to a province, &c.
9 A religious obligation or observance.
10 Semen virile.
11 A lover, a hus band.
E.
वि before षि to bind, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Dubious, uncertain.
2 Doubting.
E.
विशय doubt, इनि aff., or वि before शी to sleep, णिनि aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
1 Attached to objects of sense, carnal, sensual.
2 Conversant with or interested in worldly occupations or enjoyments.
n. (-यि)
An organ of sense.
m. (-यी)
1 A king.
2 The deity

KĀMA.
3

A sensualist.
4 A materialist, one who denies the existence of any thing which is not an object of sense.
5 A man of business or of the world.
E.
विषय an organ of sense, aff. इन्.

m. (-रः)
Killing, slaying, slaughter.
E.
वि before शृ to injure or kill, aff. अप्; also with ल्युट्, aff. विशरण n. (-णं).

m. (-रः)
A snake.
E.
विष poison, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
1 A multitude, an assemblage, a flock, a herd, a crowd.
2 Spreading, extending, going forth or abroad.
E.
वि before सृ to go, aff. अप्.

m. (-रः)
1 A fish.
2 Going smoothly, creeping, gliding.
n. (-रं)
Wood, timber.
f. (-री)
The region of the winds.
E.
वि before सृ to go, and घञ् aff., or वि priv., and सार pith.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
1 Free from thorns or spikes.
2 Free from care or pain.
f. (-ल्या)
1 A twining shrub, (Menispermum cordifolium.)
2 A sort of potherb, the kind not ascertained.
3 A plant, commonly Danti, (Croton polyandrum.)
4 Another, commonly Teori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
5 A sort of fruit, Langaliya.
E.
वि privative, and शल्य a stalk or stem.

m. (-कृत्)
A plant, (Echites dichotoma, Rox.)

n. (-नं)
1 Killing, slaying, slaughter.
2 Dissecting, cutting.
m. (-नः)
A sabre, a crooked sword.
E.
वि before शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Hurt, killed.
2 Cut, dissected.
3 Wellmannered.
E.
वि before शस to injure, aff. क्त, and इट् augment.

Killing.
2

Dissecting.
E.
वि before शस to kill, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Praised, celebrated.
2 Arrogant, ill-mannered, rude.
E.
वि before शस to praise, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं)
Disarmed, unarmed.
E.
वि, and शस्त्र a weapon.

m. (-रः)
A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.)

mfn. (-खः-खा-खं)
Branchless.
m. (-खः)
1

KĀRTTIKEYA.
2

An attitude in shooting, standing with the feet a span apart.
3 A solicitor, a petitioner, a beggar.
4 A spindle.
f. (-खा)
The sixteenth lunar asterism, figured by a festoon, and containing four, or according to some, two stars, one of which is α or κ

Libra.
2

A cucurbitaceous plant, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
वि without, शाख a branch, or विशाखा the asterism, (by which personified the god was cherished,) अण् aff., and the vowel unchanged.

m. (-जः)
The orange, (Citrus aurantium.)
E.
विशाख the asterism, and जन् to be born; aff. ड; coming into season, when the sun is in this asterism, or about the end of October.

n. (-लं)
An attitude in shooting.
E.
विशाखा the same, and लच् pleonasm.

n. (-णं)
Killing, slaying, slaughter.
E.
वि before शॄ to injure, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Learned, wise.
2 Confident, bold, presuming.
3 Famous, celebrated.
E.
विशाल great, extensive, (fame, &c.) and दा to give, aff. क, the ल changed to र.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Great, large.
2

Broad.
3

Great, eminent, illustrious.
m. (-लः)
1 A sort of deer.
2 A sort of bird.
f. (-ला)
1 The city

Ougein.
2

Bitter apple, (Cucumis colocynthis.)
E.
वि particle, and शालच् aff., or विश to enter, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.

m. (-लः)
Poison, venom.
E.
विष poison, लच् aff.

n. (-लं)
A shoot, a sprout.
E.
वि variously, सल to go, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Well born.
n. (-लं)
An illustrious family.
E.
विशाल, and कुल race.

f. (-ता)
1 Width, breadth.
2 Magnitude, bulk.
2 Eminence, distinction.
E.
विशाल large, तल् aff. of the abstract; also विशालत्व n. (-त्वं)

m. (-त्वक्)
A tree, (Echites scholaris.)
E.
विशाल large, and त्वच् skin or bark.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं)
Having large or beautiful eyes.
m. (-क्षः)
1 Ś

IVA.
2

GARUḌA.
f. (-क्षी)
PĀRVATĪ.
E.
विशाल large, and अक्षि the eye, टच् aff.

m. (-खः)
1 An arrow.
2 An iron crow.
f. (-खा)
1 A spade, a hoe.
2 A highway, a broad or carriage road.
3 A very minute arrow, a sort of needle or spindle.
4 A barber's wife.
5 A sick room, or the dwelling of the sick.
E.
वि implying possessed of, &c., and शिखा a crest.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Sounding.
E.
वि before शिजि to sound, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sharpened.
E.
वि before शि to sharpen, क्त aff.

n. (-पं)
A palace, a temple.
E.
विश to enter, अप Uṇādi aff., and इ substituted for the pen. vowel.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Endowed with, possessed of, having, inherent or attached to.
2 Excellent, superior, distinguished.
3 Especial, peculiar.
4 Having distinctive and exclusive properties.
E.
वि before शिष to tell qualities, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
1 Excellence, distinction.
2 Individuality, having distinguishing or characteristic qualities.
3 Peculiarity, as of duty, &c.
E.
तल् added to the last; also विशिष्टत्न.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
1 Dry, dried up, withered, decayed.
2 Wasted, impaired.
E.
वि before शॄ to injure, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
To crumble or fall to ruin, likely or fit to.
E.
वि before शॄ to injure, यत् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Being wasted or destroyed, decaying, perishing.
E.
वि before शॄ to injure, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Ill-behaved, indecorous, immoral.
E.
वि priv., शील behaved.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed, free from vice or fault.
2 Pious, virtuous.
3 Humble, modest, compliant.
4 Corrected.
E.
वि intensitive prefix, and शुद्ध pure, clean.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 Purity, purification.
2 Equality, similarity.
3 Removal of doubt.
4

Correctness.
5

In Algebra, a subtractive quantity.
E.
वि before शुद्धि purity.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Pure, free from soil or vice.
E.
विशुद्धि, and भाज् who shares.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Unchecked, unrestrained, unfettered, (literally or figuratively.)
E.
वि privative, and शृङ्खला a chain.

m. (-षः)
1 Sort, kind, manner.
2 Difference, individual or specific identity and consequent distinction from every other individual or species.
3 (In logic,) The peculiar attribute, (predicabile proprium,) the cause of perception of exclusion.
4 Excellence, superiority.
5 A limb, a member.
6 A mark on the forehead with

Sandal.
7

A figure of rhetoric, distinguished as of three kinds, all implying variety of means or effect.
E.
वि discriminative prefix, शिष to attribute or distinguish by attributes, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Discriminative, distinguishing, attributive, characteristic.
mn. (-कः-कं)
1 A mark on the forehead made with Sandal, &c., and worn either as an ornament or sectarial distinction.
2 An attribute, a predicate.
3 An arrangement of poetical composition.
E.
वि before शिष to attribute, or distinguish, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Amorous, desirous.
E.
विशेष, and काम who desires.

m. (-णः)
An object of a single and distinct kind, as the soul, mind, time, place, and the atoms of earth, water, light, and air.
E.
विशेष, and गुण property.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Wise, intelligent.
E.
विशेष, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Discriminative, attributive.
2 Distinctive, (as a property, &c.)
n. (-णं)
1 Distinguishing, discriminating.
2 An epithet, an attribute, an adjective.
E.
वि before शिष to distinguish by attributes, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be discriminated or distinguished, what may or ought to be marked as distinct.
E.
वि before शिष to distinguish, अनीयर् aff.

ind.
Especially, particularly, specifically.
E.
विशेष, and तसि aff.

m. (-र्म्मः)
Peculiar or different duty.
E.
विशेष, and घर्म्म duty.

f. (-ना)
1 Reflecting on or perceiving differences.
2 (In algebra,) Composition by the difference of the products.
E.
विशेष, and भावना considering.

n. (-णं)
Specific or characteristic mark or sign.
E.
विशेष, and लक्षण mark.

n. (-नं)
Special or different text.
E.
विशेष, and वचन a text.

m. (-द्वान्)
A sage, a philosopher.
E.
विशेष excellence, and विद्वान् learned.

f. (-घिः)
Special rule or observance.
E.
विशेष, and विधि rule.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Divided, distinguished, separated.
2 Predicated, attributed, having as an attribute or being distinguished by it.
3 Excellent, superior.
E.
विशेष sort, kind, &c., इतच् aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 A figure of rhetoric, coupling cause with effect, so as to explain any peculiar manner or condition.
2 Panegyric, recapitulation of merits.
E.
विशेष sort, kind, and उक्ति saying.

mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं)
To be distinguished or discriminated.
2 Distinguishing, to be discriminated by.
3 Principal, primary, chief.
m. (-ष्यः)
A name, a substantive.
n. (-ष्यं)
The object of a predicate.
E.
वि before शिष to distinguish by its attributes, and ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Without grief, happy.
E.
वि priv., शोक sorrow.

n. (-नं)
Cleaning, purifying, freeing from soil, defect, or sin.
f. (-नी)
1 A plant, commonly

Nāgadanti.
2

The capital of BRAHMĀ.
E.
वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be cleaned or purified, to be freed from soil, fault, &c.
E.
वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., अनीयर् aff.; also विशोधितव्य and विशोध्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Purified, cleansed, freed from soil, &c.
E.
वि before शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त aff.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Cleaning, purifying.
2 Clearing, freeing from obstructions.
E.
विशोघिन्, and त्व aff.; also with तल्, विशोधिता.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
1 Cleaning, purifying.
2 Clearing.
E.
वि before शुध to be pure, causal v., णिनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Drying, desiccating.
E.
वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dried, dried up.
E.
वि before शुष to be dry, causal v., क्त aff.

m. (-श्नः)
Lustre, shining.
E.
विच्छ to shine, नङ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Gift, giving, donation.
E.
वि before श्रण to give, ल्युट् aff.; also विश्राणन.

n. (-णं)
Gift, giving, donation.
E.
वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Trusted, confided in, confided to.
2 Patient, tranquil.
3 Lowly-minded, not lofty, not magnanimous. []
4 Excessive, exceeding, much.
5 Firm, steady.
6 Rested, reposed.
E.
वि before श्रम to be weary or स्रम्भ to trust, &c. aff. क्तः see विस्रब्ध.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
1 Trusted, confided in.
2 Placid, tamed, humble.
3 Steady, diligent.
E.
वि before स्रंभ to trust, aff. क्त.

f. (-ता)
Trust-worthiness.
E.
विश्रब्ध, and तल् aff.

m. (-मः)
Rest, repose, cessation from fatigue or work.
E.
वि privative, श्रम to be weary, aff. अच्; also विश्राम.

m. (-मः)
1 Rest, repose.
2 Pause, stop, cessation.
3 Tranquillity, composure.
E.
वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wearied, exhausted.
E.
विश्रम, and इतच् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Trust, confidence.
2 Affection, affectionate inquiry.
3 Festive or sportive noise or tumult.
E.
वि before स्रम्भ to trust, aff. घञ्, and the initial optionally changed; also विस्रम्भ.

m. (-म्भः)
1 Trust, confidence.
2 Affection, regard, affectionate solicitation.
3

Acquaintance.
4

Killing.
E.
वि before स्रम्भ^1 to trust, aff. घञ्.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

ind.
Having rested.
E.
वि before श्रम to be weary, ल्यप् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Abode, asylum.
2 Dependance upon.
E.
वि, श्री to serve, श aff.

mfn. (-यी-यिणी-यि)
1 Living or dwelling in.
2 Serving, depending on.
E.
वि before श्री to serve, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bestowed, given.
E.
वि before श्रण to give, r. 10th cl. क्त aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Rested, reposed.
2 Ceasing, desisting from.
3 Calm, composed.
E.
वि before श्रान्त the same.

f. (-न्तिः)
Rest, repose, cessation from toil or occupation.
E.
वि before श्रम to be weary, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-वः)
1 Fame, celebrity.
2 Flowing, dropping.
E.
वि before श्रु to hear or to drop, aff. घञ्.

n. (-णं)
1 Causing to flow or drop.
2

Bleeding.
3

Apprising, causing to hear.
E.
वि before श्रु to ooze, &c., causal v., ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Causing to flow.
2

Bleeding.
3

Distilling.
4

A spirit distilled from molasses.
E.
वि before स्रु to drop, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Famous, celebrated, notorious.
2

Known.
3

Pleased, delighted, happy.
4 Dropped, flowing.
E.
वि before श्रुत heard.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spread, stretched.
2 Dropped, flowing.
E.
वि apart, स्रु to go, क्त aff.

f. (-तिः)
1 Celebrity, fame, notoriety.
2 Oozing, flowing.
E.
वि before श्रु to hear, aff. क्तिन्.

mfn. (-थः-था-थं)
Languid, relaxed.
E.
वि before श्लथ loose.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Weak, relaxed, nerveless.
E.
विश्लथ, and अङ्ग the body.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
Separated, disunited.
E.
वि before श्लिष to unite, क्त aff.

m. (-षः)
1 Separation, distance, especially of lovers, or husband and wife.
2 Disunion, disjunction, separation in general.
3 (In arithmetic,) The converse of addition.
E.
वि before श्लिष to unite, aff. घञ्.

f. (-तिः)
(In arithmetic,) The assimilation of difference, the reduction of fractional difference.
E.
विश्लेष, and जाति kind.

mfn. (-श्वः-श्वा-श्वं)
All, entire, whole, universal.
n. (-श्वं)
